multipliers.name: Global Multiplier
multipliers.behavior:
The global multiplier is persistent during free drops.
Bet amount and balance are always displayed in the info bar at the bottom of the game view in the currency that the player has chosen. This information is always available throughout the gaming session.

specials.name: Elmo
specials.behavior: the Elmo Wild Drops feature. Elmo walks 1 column to the left and places a random amount of Wild symbols on the grid for every redrop. Wild symbols last until Elmo has left the leftmost column or if they have contributed to a win.

base_game_loop.summary: Hula Balua: paid spin on 6x6. Scatter Pays. Avalanche/tumble after wins. Bonus modes: Bonus, Super Bonus. Round ends on win cap if reached.

phases.name: Place bet and spin
phases.what_happens: Player selects bet and hits Spin (or Auto Spin). Optional: activate an X-iter mode from base game only before the drop/spin.
phases.state_changes: Bet locked; optional X-iter mode selected

phases.name: Initial symbol drop/spin
phases.what_happens: Symbols land on 6x6. Game-specific setup features may fire (birds, Nitro/COOL reels, collectors, etc.).
phases.ends_when: All symbols at resting positions / reels stopped

phases.name: Remove winners and Avalanche
phases.what_happens: Winning symbols explode/are removed; remaining symbols fall; new symbols drop in. Continues while new wins appear.
phases.ends_when: No new winning combinations after a fill
phases.state_changes: Grid updated; avalanche chain may continue

phases.name: End-of-drop features
phases.what_happens: Resolve end-of-round features (bombs, mystery reveals, row swaps, boosters, etc.) if nothing else can happen; may resume avalanches.

phases.name: Bonus trigger check
phases.what_happens: If bonus/super-bonus trigger conditions met, enter bonus mode after resolving same-drop features. Otherwise settle base-game wins subject to win cap.
phases.state_changes: Enter bonus mode or settle base round

Game description
Hula Balua takes place deep in the magical forest, where the sloth Elmo lives in symbiosis with nature.
The game is a scatter game with 6 columns, 6 rows and dropping symbols.
Hula Balua is a scatter game where 8 or more identical symbols anywhere on the grid is a win. There are no pay lines.
3 or more Bonus symbols appearing anywhere on the main grid at the end of a symbol drop in normal mode triggers the free drop Bonus game. Two Bonus symbols vertically connected on top of each other upgrades all Bonus symbols into Super Bonus symbols.
 • 3 Bonus symbols: 6 free drops
 • 4 Bonus symbols: 8 free drops
 • 5 Bonus symbols: 10 free drops
 • 6 Bonus symbols: 12 free drops
 

The Bonus game starts with a new set of symbols on the grid. The global multiplier is persistent during free drops.
